{{Quote|You served on the ''Intrepid'' during the mission into the Unknown Regions.''"<br />"''Your memory sservess you well, Masster Ssinde. You could rival a Jenet.|Treis Sinde and Bor Alsek, crewmembers on the Intrepid|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 32">[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]</ref>}}
'''''Intrepid''''' was an Imperial craft that served the [[Fel Empire]]. At some point prior to the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the craft departed on a mission to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Sluissi]] technician, [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Bor Alsek]] and [[Imperial Knight]] [[Treis Sinde]] served aboard the ''Intrepid'' on this mission. They would not meet again until the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].
